request.prompt:
Create one isolated full-body production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, faithfully reproducing the specific original game character and exact alternate costume in the attached reference. Detailed realistic game-render finish, neutral studio illumination, crisp readable silhouette. Preserve original anatomy, proportions, model-side asymmetries, material colors, seams and costume parts. Exactly ONE subject and ONE static view. Keep head, hands, legs and both complete feet within the canvas with generous transparent padding. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no scenery, ground plane, floor shadow, labels, text or logo. No redesign, invented equipment, weapon, effects or additional figure.

Subject: Tali'Zorah in her canonical LOYALTY outfit from Mass Effect 2. The FIRST image is the exact selected costume and pose authority, a complete front three-quarter figure facing slightly image-left. Preserve the pale gray patterned hood and cloth, the black environmental undersuit, warm ochre/orange-gold edging and chest/waist fastenings, opaque violet faceplate with its original reflections, round mask respirator, original segmented guards and the long narrow lower-leg armor, quarian split-toed boots, and the small side-mounted calf component. Her right hand rests near her hip as in the source and the other arm is relaxed. Match the placement and number of horizontal torso straps and diagonal hip fabric. The SECOND image is the original artist model sheet for anatomical construction, fabric swirl motifs and feet; it includes a purple default version which must NOT replace the loyalty palette in the first image. Keep the face completely behind the original opaque helmet faceplate. Do not change her species, clothing coverage, armor layout or stance.
